description: Rollback contract: on validator failure after staged apply, restore exact pre-apply bytes or remove newly-created file. Never claim success before validation.

contract.pre_existing_target: restore original bytes from same-directory backup via atomic rename
contract.absent_target_before_apply: remove the newly-created target file, restoring non-existence
contract.io_partial_failure: return IoPartialWrite with validator and rollback failure detail; filesystem state uncertain, requires operator inspection/recovery

test_cases.scenario: Existing file replaced; validator fails; original bytes restored byte-for-byte
test_cases.expected: file content equals pre-apply snapshot; receipt revalidation = proposed -> applied -> validation-failed -> restored

test_cases.scenario: Absent target created by apply; validator fails; target removed
test_cases.expected: target does not exist after rollback; receipt revalidation = proposed -> applied -> validation-failed -> restored

test_cases.scenario: Backup rename fails during rollback; error preserved as IoPartialWrite
test_cases.expected: IoPartialWrite containing both validator and rollback failure details; filesystem state uncertain, requires operator inspection/recovery
